description: Move multiple tasks to one list or workspace. Each task needs: taskId or taskName + listName. Target: targetListId or targetListName. Cross-workspace discovery is automatic: server searches all available workspaces for source and destination. Uses TIML (ID-preserving) by default for intra-workspace. IF BLOCKED by plan limits for intra-workspace move, you MUST ask for permission to use allowDestructiveFallback.

allowDestructiveFallback.description: Set to true ONLY AFTER EXPLICIT USER CONSENT. Allows Copy-Delete move if TIML is forbidden. Warning: ALL Task IDs will change and history will reset.

options.description: Processing options. JSON strings are auto-parsed.

taskName.description: Task name. Automatically resolved to ID. Requires listName

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: move_bulk_tasks
